headlines.title: 私募个人合格投资者门槛：金融资产不低于500万或近三年年均收入不低于50万
headlines.summary: 金十数据9月4日讯，证监会正就《私募投资基金募集监督管理办法》征求意见，旨在进一步加强对私募投资基金募集业务活动监管。《管理办法》拟规定，个人认定为合格投资者需具有二年以上证券、基金、期货、股权等投资经历，且家庭金融资产不低于500万元，或家庭金融净资产不低于300万元，或近三年本人年均收入不低于50万元，并具备相应风险识别和承担能力。对于主要财产投向不动产项目公司股权、单一标的、境外资产、场外衍生品等的私募基金，自然人投资者应具有四年以上投资经历，家庭金融资产不低于1000万元，家庭金融净资产不低于600万元。

headlines.title_en: Private fund individual qualified investor threshold: financial assets no less than RMB 5 million or average annual income no less than RMB 500,000 over the past three years
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data September 4 - The CSRC is soliciting opinions on the 'Measures for the Supervision and Administration of Private Offering Fund Raising', aiming to further strengthen supervision over private fund raising activities. The draft measures stipulate that individuals qualifying as qualified investors must have at least two years of investment experience in securities, funds, futures, equity, etc., and have household financial assets of no less than RMB 5 million, or household financial net assets of no less than RMB 3 million, or average annual personal income of no less than RMB 500,000 over the past three years, along with corresponding risk identification and bearing capabilities. For private funds primarily investing in real estate project company equity, single targets, overseas assets, OTC derivatives, etc., individual investors should have at least four years of investment experience, household financial assets of no less than RMB 10 million, and household financial net assets of no less than RMB 6 million.

headlines.title: 中国人民银行：稳步深化金融改革和对外开放，进一步提升金融管理和服务水平
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行召开党委扩大会议暨党建工作领导小组会议。会议要求，全系统要坚持以正确政绩观引领金融高质量发展，立足央行职能职责，坚持为人民出政绩、以实干出政绩，落实好“十五五”规划纲要各项任务，实施好适度宽松的货币政策，高质量推进金融“五篇大文章”，稳妥化解重点领域风险，稳步深化金融改革和对外开放，进一步提升金融管理和服务水平，确保党中央各项决策部署落地见效，努力创造更多经得起实践、人民、历史检验的实绩。

headlines.title_en: PBOC: Steadily deepen financial reform and opening-up, further enhance financial management and service levels
headlines.summary_en: The People's Bank of China held a Party Committee enlarged meeting and Party Building Leading Group meeting. The meeting required the entire system to adhere to a correct view of political achievements to guide high-quality financial development, based on the central bank's functions and responsibilities, persist in making achievements for the people and through practical work, implement the tasks in the '15th Five-Year Plan' outline, implement an appropriately loose monetary policy, advance the 'five major articles' of high-quality finance, prudently resolve risks in key areas, steadily deepen financial reform and opening up, further improve financial management and service levels, ensure all decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee are effectively implemented, and strive to create more achievements that stand the test of practice, the people, and history.

headlines.title: 证监会明确私募个人合格投资者条件：家庭金融资产不低于500万或近三年年均收入不低于50万

headlines.title_en: CSRC clarifies private fund individual qualified investor conditions: household financial assets no less than RMB 5 million or average annual income no less than RMB 500,000 over the past three years
headlines.summary_en: On September 4, the CSRC publicly solicited opinions on the 'Measures for the Supervision and Administration of Private Offering Fund Raising (Draft for Comments)'. The document clarifies conditions for individuals to be recognized as qualified investors, including having at least two years of investment experience in securities, funds, futures, equity, etc., or serving as senior management personnel of relevant institutions as stipulated; household financial assets of no less than RMB 5 million, or household financial net assets of no less than RMB 3 million, or average annual personal income of no less than RMB 500,000 over the past three years.

headlines.title: 三部门：先进制造业企业需在2026年内具备高新技术企业资格
headlines.summary: 工业和信息化部、财政部、国家税务总局联合发布通知，明确了2026年度享受增值税加计抵减政策的先进制造业企业名单制定工作的相关事项。通知指出，先进制造业企业需在2026年内具备高新技术企业资格，并且2025年期间研发支出、研发人员、高新技术产品占比需符合相关规定。同时，企业需满足制造业销售额占比50%以上等条件，并确保在申请名单前36个月内未发生骗取退税或虚开增值税发票等行为。

headlines.title_en: Three departments: Advanced manufacturing enterprises must hold High-tech Enterprise qualification by 2026
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Finance, and the State Taxation Administration jointly issued a notice, clarifying matters related to the formulation of the list of advanced manufacturing enterprises eligible for VAT additional deduction policies in 2026. The notice states that advanced manufacturing enterprises must have high-tech enterprise qualification within 2026, and during 2025, R&D expenditures, R&D personnel, and the proportion of high-tech products must meet relevant regulations. Additionally, enterprises must meet conditions such as manufacturing sales accounting for more than 50%, and ensure no fraudulent tax rebates or false issuance of VAT invoices occurred within 36 months before applying for the list.

headlines.title: 中国证监会就《私募投资基金募集监督管理办法（征求意见稿）》公开征求意见
headlines.summary: 《募集办法》共七章四十五条，主要内容包括：一是明确“卖者尽责、买者自负”的基本原则，明确募集方式，细化禁止性行为规范。二是完善合格投资者资产规模、收入水平和投资经历等认定标准，强化穿透监管要求。三是明确资金募集过程、募集文件和监管要求，压实私募投资基金管理人、私募投资基金销售机构适当性管理义务与风险揭示义务。四是完善保障募集资金安全机制，明确对募集结算专用账户、募集结算资金监督机构等的要求，加强对私募投资基金管理人内控制度建设要求。五是明确监督管理和法律责任。

headlines.title_en: CSRC solicits public comments on the 'Measures for the Supervision and Administration of Private Investment Fund Raising (Draft for Comments)'
headlines.summary_en: The 'Raising Measures' consist of seven chapters and 45 articles, with main contents including: First, clarifying the basic principle of 'sellers fulfill their duties, buyers bear their own risks', clarifying raising methods, and detailing prohibited conduct rules. Second, improving the recognition standards for qualified investors' asset scale, income levels, and investment experience, and strengthening look-through supervision requirements. Third, clarifying the capital raising process, offering documents, and regulatory requirements, and strengthening the suitability management obligations and risk disclosure obligations of private fund managers and private fund sales institutions. Fourth, improving mechanisms to ensure the safety of raised funds, clarifying requirements for dedicated raising settlement accounts and raising settlement fund supervision institutions, and strengthening requirements for internal control system construction of private fund managers. Fifth, clarifying supervision and legal liability.

headlines.title: 86吨黄金转移出纽约和渥太华！荷兰央行回应：便于危机下快速调动，而存放伦敦交易执行阻力极小
headlines.summary: 当地时间9月2日，荷兰央行宣布，今年3至8月，将约86吨黄金储备从美国纽约、加拿大渥太华转移至英国伦敦，操作包含市场交易与实物调运两种方式。 荷兰央行表示，在日益不确定的全球环境下，此次调整核心目标是进一步加强危机应对能力；伦敦是全球实物黄金重要交易中心，从可售性与流动性角度具备额外优势，存放在此，危机情况下有助于实现更快速、更高效的交易和调动。该行称对北美托管黄金仍充满信心，目前尚无进一步搬迁计划。

headlines.title_en: 86 tons of gold transferred out of New York and Ottawa! Dutch central bank responds: to facilitate rapid mobilization in crises, while London offers minimal friction for trade execution
headlines.summary_en: On September 2 local time, the Dutch central bank announced that from March to August this year, approximately 86 tonnes of gold reserves were transferred from New York, USA and Ottawa, Canada to London, UK, involving both market transactions and physical transportation. The Dutch central bank stated that amid the increasingly uncertain global environment, the core goal of this adjustment is to further strengthen crisis response capabilities; London is an important global trading center for physical gold, offering additional advantages in terms of sellability and liquidity. Gold stored there helps achieve faster and more efficient trading and mobilization in crisis situations. The bank stated it remains confident in gold custodied in North America and currently has no plans for further relocation.

headlines.title: 内蒙古首笔“算力Token贷”发放
headlines.summary: 近日，中国银行内蒙古分行为内蒙古和林格尔新区发放内蒙古自治区首笔“算力Token贷”。这笔贷款通过创新授信评价体系，打破传统信贷依赖抵押担保的固有模式，将企业词元使用规模、算力合作订单、核心技术资质、科创研发能力等新兴指标纳入核心授信评估体系，为词元经济相关企业量身定制专属普惠科创金融产品，开创了金融支持词元经济发展的新路径。 目前，算力产业已经成为呼和浩特市重点产业之一，全市算力规模达15万P，其中智算14.6万P，绿色算力指数位居全国首位。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Inner Mongolia issues its first 'Computing Power Token Loan'
headlines.summary_en: Recently, Bank of China Inner Mongolia Branch issued Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region's first 'Computing Power Token Loan' to Hohhot New Area of Inner Mongolia. This loan breaks the traditional credit model that relies on collateral and guarantees by incorporating emerging indicators such as enterprise token usage scale, computing power cooperation orders, core technology qualifications, and sci-tech R&D capabilities into the core credit assessment system, tailoring exclusive inclusive sci-tech financial products for token economy-related enterprises, opening a new path for financial support of the token economy. Currently, the computing power industry has become one of Hohhot's key industries, with the city's computing power scale reaching 150,000P, of which intelligent computing accounts for 146,000P, ranking first nationally in the green computing power index. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 证监会对元道通信欺诈发行及信息披露违法行为进行行政处罚
headlines.summary: 证监会对元道通信股份有限公司及其时任董事长李晋、董事吴志锋、副总经理兼财务总监曹亚蕾的欺诈发行及信息披露违法行为作出行政处罚。经查明，2019年至2022年，元道通信通过虚构工作量确认单等方式虚增营业收入，其公告的证券发行文件中编造重大虚假内容，2022年年度报告信息披露存在虚假记载。

headlines.title_en: CSRC imposes administrative penalties on Yuandao Communication for fraudulent issuance and information disclosure violations
headlines.summary_en: The CSRC has imposed administrative penalties on Yuandao Communication Co., Ltd. and its then-chairman Li Jin, director Wu Zhifeng, and deputy general manager and CFO Cao Yalei for fraudulent issuance and information disclosure violations. Investigations found that from 2019 to 2022, Yuandao Communication inflated operating revenue through methods such as fabricating workload confirmation forms, fabricated major false content in its announced securities issuance documents, and its 2022 annual report contained false records in information disclosure.

headlines.title: Extra funds push Taiwan’s defence spending past NT$1 trillion for the first time
headlines.summary:
Taiwan’s cabinet approved a supplementary defence budget of NT$145.7 billion (US$4.6 billion) on Thursday, pushing the island’s total defence-related spending for this year above NT$1 trillion for the first time.
The additional funding is expected to raise this year’s overall defence spending from 3.32 per cent of gross domestic product (GDP) to about 3.83 per cent, the highest level in decades.

headlines.title_zh: 追加资金使台湾防务支出首次突破新台币1万亿元
headlines.summary_zh:
台湾行政院周四批准了一项1457亿新台币（约46亿美元）的追加国防预算，使该岛今年的国防相关支出总额首次突破1万亿新台币。
预计这笔额外资金将使今年的整体国防支出从占国内生产总值（GDP）的3.32%提高到约3.83%

headlines.title_en: PBOC: 50 billion yuan outright reverse repo operation set for September 7
headlines.summary_en: PBOC: To conduct 500 billion yuan outright reverse repo operations on September 7 — On September 7, 2026, the People's Bank of China will conduct a 500 billion yuan outright reverse repo operation via fixed quantity, interest rate bidding, and multiple-price auction, with a term of 3 months (89 days) and maturity on December 5, 2026.

headlines.title_en: Kangxin New Materials: Placed under investigation by CSRC for suspected information disclosure violations in periodic reports
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data September 4 - Kangxin New Materials announced that the company received a 'Case Filing Notice' from the CSRC on September 4, 2026. Due to suspected information disclosure violations in periodic reports, the CSRC decided to file a case against the company. Currently, all business operations are proceeding normally, and the company will actively cooperate with the investigation and fulfill information disclosure obligations.

headlines.title: 证监会：加强对私募基金管理人合规风控管理和财务管理等内控制度建设
headlines.summary: 中国证监会就《私募投资基金募集监督管理办法（征求意见稿）》公开征求意见。其中提出， 一是明确私募基金管理人、私募基金销售机构开立募集结算专用账户要求，为资金独立性提供基本保障。二是结合行业实践，由专门的募集结算资金监督机构对专用账户财产进行监督，建立健全对账机制，私募基金管理人、私募基金销售机构应当积极配合。三是加强对私募基金管理人合规风控管理和财务管理等内控制度建设，完善对私募基金销售机构委托管理要求，明确各方依法依规履行职责。

headlines.title_en: CSRC: Strengthen internal control system construction for private fund managers in compliance risk management and financial management
headlines.summary_en: The CSRC publicly solicited opinions on the 'Measures for the Supervision and Administration of Private Offering Fund Raising (Draft for Comments)'. It proposes: First, clarifying requirements for private fund managers and private fund sales institutions to open dedicated raising settlement accounts, providing basic guarantees for capital independence. Second, combining industry practice, dedicated raising settlement fund supervision institutions will supervise property in dedicated accounts, establishing and improving reconciliation mechanisms, with private fund managers and sales institutions required to actively cooperate. Third, strengthening internal control system construction for compliance risk management and financial management of private fund managers, improving requirements for entrusted management of private fund sales institutions, and clarifying that all parties perform their duties in accordance with laws and regulations.

headlines.title: 证监会：《募集办法》明确资金募集过程和监管要求

headlines.title_en: CSRC: The 'Raising Measures' clarify the fund-raising process and regulatory requirements
headlines.summary_en: The 'Measures for the Supervision and Administration of Private Offering Fund Raising (Draft for Comments)' clarifies that private fund raising includes the entire process of investor suitability assessment and matching, product promotion, risk disclosure, qualified investor confirmation, and fund contract signing, with regulations for each link. Second, it strengthens the suitability management and risk disclosure obligations of private fund managers and private fund sales institutions, with detailed regulations focusing on suitability assessment content, standards, procedures, and general risk disclosure, special risk disclosure, etc., strengthening the 'sellers fulfill their duties' requirement. Third, it details requirements for offering documents, stipulating provisions on promotional materials such as prospectuses, risk disclosure statements, investor commitment letters, and fund contracts, clarifying rights and obligations relationships between parties and dispute resolution requirements. headlines.title: 张国清出席第三十二次亚太经合组织中小企业部长会议开幕式并致辞
headlines.summary: 第三十二次亚太经合组织（APEC）中小企业部长会议4日在广东广州举行，中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理张国清出席开幕式并致辞。 张国清表示，中方愿与各方一道，积极落实四大全球倡议，持续深挖合作潜力，共同打造协同融通的创新生态，营造公平公正的市场环境，构建普惠共享的服务体系，加强务实有效的区域合作，携手推动更多中小企业拔节生长、蓬勃壮大，为构建开放、活力、强韧、和平的亚太共同体贡献积极力量。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Zhang Guoqing attends and addresses the opening ceremony of the 32nd APEC SME Ministerial Meeting
headlines.summary_en: The 32nd APEC SME Ministerial Meeting was held in Guangzhou, Guangdong on the 4th. Zhang Guoqing, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, attended and addressed the opening ceremony. Zhang Guoqing stated that China is willing to work with all parties to actively implement the four major global initiatives, continuously explore cooperation potential, jointly build a synergistic and interconnected innovation ecosystem, create a fair and just market environment, build an inclusive and shared service system, strengthen practical and effective regional cooperation, and jointly promote the growth and prosperity of more SMEs, contributing positive strength to building an open, vibrant, resilient, and peaceful Asia-Pacific community. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 中美或将就农业及相关非关税壁垒发布声明？外交部：无信息提供
headlines.summary: 外交部发言人郭嘉昆主持例行记者会。有记者提问，美国贸易代表格里尔周四表示，中美或将就农业及相关非关税壁垒发布有关声明。外交部对此有何评论？中方对于两国元首下次互动有何期待？ 郭嘉昆表示，关于你提到的具体问题，我没有可以提供的信息。中美双方应当共同落实好两国元首达成的重要共识，维护中美经贸关系稳定发展态势。（澎湃）

headlines.title_en: China and US may issue a statement on agriculture and related non-tariff barriers? MFA: No information available
headlines.summary_en: Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Guo Jiakun held a regular press conference. A reporter asked that US Trade Representative Greer said on Thursday that China and the US may issue statements regarding agriculture and related non-tariff barriers. What is the Foreign Ministry's comment? What expectations does China have for the next interaction between the two heads of state? Guo Jiakun said, regarding the specific issue you mentioned, I have no information to provide. China and the US should jointly implement the important consensus reached by the two heads of state and maintain the stable development trend of China-US economic and trade relations. (The Paper)

headlines.title: 养老理财产品新一轮扩围在即 有公司已上报材料
headlines.summary: 记者从多家银行理财公司了解到，在此前一轮试点基础上，新一轮养老理财产品的扩围有望很快落地。“我们已经报了材料，后续看审批情况。”一家头部银行理财子业务部门负责人对记者表示。据记者汇总了解，满足监管条件的机构最早有望于9月底获批发行新一批养老理财产品，部分机构已开始准备产品发行相关事宜。进入准备阶段的机构，包括已发行过养老理财产品的公司，也包括从未发行相关产品的公司。中国理财网数据显示，截至目前共10家理财公司发行 51只养老理财产品。（财联社）

headlines.title_en: New round of expansion for pension wealth management products imminent; some firms have submitted materials
headlines.summary_en: Reporters learned from multiple bank wealth management companies that, building on the previous pilot round, the expansion of a new batch of pension wealth management products is expected to land soon. “We have submitted materials, and the rest depends on the review outcome,” a business department head at a leading bank wealth management subsidiary told reporters. According to aggregated reporting, institutions meeting regulatory conditions are expected to receive approval to issue a new batch of pension wealth management products as early as end-September, with some already preparing for product issuance. Institutions in the preparation stage include both those that have issued such products before and those that have never done so. Data from China Wealth Management Network shows that, to date, 10 wealth management companies have issued 51 pension wealth management products. (CLS)

headlines.title_en: Southbound capital saw net selling of 10.021 billion yuan today
headlines.summary_en: Southbound capital saw a large net sell-off of 10.021 billion yuan today. On the Shanghai-Hong Kong Stock Connect, SMIC and Tencent Holdings saw net sells of 795 million HKD and 621 million HKD respectively; Kingboard Laminates topped net buys with 502 million HKD. On the Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect, Tencent Holdings and Xiaomi Corporation-W saw net sells of 1.481 billion HKD and 746 million HKD respectively; MiniMax-W topped net buys with 666 million HKD.

headlines.title_en: CASSTAR Mi Lei: Hard tech is not a short-term investment trend; capital must truly settle in for the long haul
headlines.summary_en: Hard-tech companies are intensively knocking on the doors of the capital market. Last night (September 3), the IPO lottery result for Enflame Technology was announced, bringing it a step closer to listing on the A-share market. Earlier, Moore Threads and MetaX, also among the ‘Four Domestic GPU Dragons,’ listed on the STAR Market at the end of last year, while Biren Technology listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at the start of the year. Facing the hard-tech wave, how can investment institutions seize opportunities and adjust their layouts? “Hard tech is not a short-term investment trend,” said Mi Lei, founding partner of CASSTAR. “This year we are investing in atomic manufacturing; in previous years, we invested in controlled nuclear fusion, 2D materials, and embodied intelligence — these are all frontier directions,” Mi Lei stated at the recent Cape of Good Hope Science Salon session on the Hard-Tech Wave. Further discussing hard-tech investment, he noted that the core of capital is to invest accurately, finance easily, and avoid waste. “Let capital truly settle down, and dig deep.”
